title: Grounding User Preferences in Shared Multimodal Concepts for Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal recommendation has substantially advanced item understanding by incorporating rich visual and textual content. Yet user preferences are still commonly encoded as implicit signals tied to individual items, leaving recurring semantic factors without persistent identities that can be shared across items. We introduce MKGE, a multimodal knowledge graph framework that represents these factors as canonical, addressable concepts. MKGE induces a domain-adaptive concept vocabulary from item images and titles, grounds each user's interaction history in supported concepts, and jointly models direct user-item evidence and concept-mediated preference signals. By turning recurring semantics into shared coordinates, MKGE enables evidence from different items to accumulate around the same preference factors. translated_title: 基于共享多模态概念锚定用户偏好的推荐方法
translated_abstract: 多模态推荐通过融合丰富的视觉和文本内容，极大地提升了对物品的理解能力。然而，用户偏好通常仍被编码为与单个物品绑定的隐式信号，导致反复出现的语义因素缺乏可跨物品共享的持久化表示。我们提出了MKGE，一个多模态知识图谱框架，将这些语义因素表示为规范的、可寻址的概念。MKGE从物品图像和标题中归纳出领域自适应的概念词表，将每个用户的交互历史锚定到被支持的概念上，并联合建模直接的用户-物品证据与经概念中介传递的偏好信号。通过将反复出现的语义转化为共享坐标，MKGE使得来自不同物品的证据能够围绕相同的偏好因素进行累积。在三个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MKGE持续优于协同过滤、知识图谱和多模态（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: MKGE是一个多模态知识图谱推荐框架，其核心创新在于将反复出现的语义因素表示为规范、可共享的概念，将用户交互历史锚定到这些概念上，并联合建模直接的用户-物品证据与概念中介的偏好信号，使偏好证据能够跨物品累积，从而在多个基准上持续超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: MKGE is a multimodal knowledge graph recommendation framework whose key innovation is representing recurring semantic factors as canonical, shared concepts—grounding user interaction histories in these concepts and jointly modeling direct user-item evidence and concept-mediated preference signals—so that evidence accumulates across items, consistently outperforming baselines on multiple benchmarks.
